meta.title: Kirara Dev Flow
meta.description: Orchestrates Kirara's three-repo development on DSH: read the docs, plan a route, build-verify, hand over a device checklist — UI work first runs a live visual loop (discover the host's Xcode / Android device-control MCP servers, drive the screen, and iterate on real screenshots so 'done' cannot be claimed unlooked-at) and then a screenshot review — sync the markdown docs, then package a release with each repo's own script — artefacts named _v<version> on the Desktop with a SHA256 checksum, gated on the new features being written into the README first.
